title: General logistic growth in humped-memory predator-prey models: reproducibility archive
description: Python scripts, input data, generated numerical data, and figures supporting the analysis of Hopf bifurcation in humped-memory predator-prey models with general logistic prey growth. Version 2.0.0 adds growth-law generality, parameter sensitivity, scenario-based uncertainty, and a matched-mean comparison with exponential memory. The manuscript source files are not included.
